description: Illustrative kye.explainer_class.v1 instance showing both class shapes: one that projects every row of its registry, and one that filters with a declarative eligibility rule plus the reason its excluded rows are excluded. Both classes here project the PUBLIC vocabulary registry: a public example may not cite an IP-track path (§33 / Hard rule #1), so the live registry — whose classes mostly project internal registries — is not reproduced here.

classes.ineligible_reason: descriptive vocabulary row, not a named mark — only a mark warrants its own explainer
classes.purpose_template: Explain the term {name}: what it means, why it is named that, and what it is NOT.
Explain the concept {name} to someone integrating against it, in the terms their own system already uses.
